title: 第56章 破防的唱片店老板

第56章 破防的唱片店老板-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

7月18日，上午9点，西单独音唱片。

吃过早饭的王磊嘴里叼着根牙签，慢慢悠悠的打开了经营近十年的小门店。

他98年来京城打拼，当时花光了手上所有积蓄盘下这家店，一路见证了国内唱片行业的兴衰起伏。

作为一名老江湖，王磊没有怨天没有尤人，而是顺应时代潮流，准备改革。

既然实体唱片落寞，那就走复合型道路。

唱片加实体书，有没有搞头？

实在不行直接改成小卖部，顺便进一些畅销歌手的专辑。

一边开小卖部，一边卖专辑，总能过下去吧？

王磊的想法得到了周边同行的赞同。

大家都想改变，奈何没这个勇气。

王磊胆子大，愿意做第一个吃螃蟹的人。

这些天他一直在联系各种图书进货渠道，只要有稳定供货渠道，他就愿意干。

不过，在此之前，还是以卖CD唱片为主。

晃晃悠悠的搬出李雨春人形展架，然后再摆上一摞专辑。

《少年中国》是目前店里卖的最好的专辑。

超级女声的脑残粉太多。

除此之外，还有前两天新进的专辑，歌手叫魏沐。

像这种新人歌手专辑一般没什么市场，门店首批进货最多也就100张左右。

不能进货太多，卖不完容易砸手里。

但魏沐不一样，太合麦田在京城砸了不少宣传资源。

至少对于王磊来说，他觉得《体面》是一首好歌。

所以，他进了200张，以防万一。

忙完手头工作，王磊抬头看了看，嗯...今儿天气不错，应该能卖上20张唱片。

一直等到10点，店里才来了第一批客人。

几个女孩，看样子是大学生，进门随便看几眼，问道：“老板，有偏爱么？”

“啥玩意？”

“偏爱！！”

其中一个女同学眼神古怪的看了一下老板，像是在看一个土老帽：“体面总知道吧？魏沐的歌。”

“嗐。魏沐我当然知道，体面嘛，MV这么火。”

王磊拍了下脑袋，从门口那一摞崭新的专辑里面翻找起来。

不多时，五张全新的专辑出现在他手中。

“是这个吗？”

女同学看了一眼，专辑封面上是个气质出众的帅气男人。

她眼睛一亮：“就是这个，老板多少钱？”

“50块。”

“这么贵？”

“里面有写真集。”

“好，我买了！！”

没过多久又来了几个年轻人，都是来问《体面》专辑

王磊左右逢迎，照单全收。

July 18, 9 a.m., Xidian Audio Records.

After having breakfast, Wang Lei slowly opened the small store that has been in business for nearly ten years with a toothpick in his mouth.

He came to the capital in 1998 to work hard. At that time, he spent all his savings to buy this store, and witnessed the ups and downs of the domestic record industry along the way.

As an old Jianghu, Wang Lei does not complain about God and others, but follows the trend of the times and prepares for reform.

Since physical records are in decline, let’s take the hybrid path.

Is there any way to combine records and physical books?

If it's not possible, just change it into a canteen and stock some albums of best-selling singers.

Opening a canteen and selling albums at the same time, you can always get by, right?

Wang Lei’s idea was endorsed by colleagues around him.

Everyone wants to change, but they don’t have the courage.

Wang Lei is brave and willing to be the first to eat crabs.

These days, he has been contacting various book purchase channels. As long as there is a stable supply channel, he is willing to do it.

However, before that, it was still mainly selling CD records.

He slowly moved out the Li Yuchun humanoid display stand, and then placed a stack of albums on it.

"Young China" is currently the best-selling album in the store.

There are too many crazy fans of Super Girl.

In addition, there is a new album released two days ago, the singer is Wei Mu.

There is generally no market for albums by new singers like this, and the first batch of stores can only purchase about 100 copies at most.

Don’t buy too much, otherwise it will be hard to sell if you don’t sell enough.

But Wei Mu was different. Taihe Maitian spent a lot of publicity resources in the capital.

At least for Wang Lei, he thinks "Decent" is a good song.

So, he entered 200, just in case.

After finishing the work at hand, Wang Lei looked up and saw, well... the weather is nice today, I should be able to sell 20 records.

It was not until 10 o'clock that the first batch of customers came to the store.

A few girls, who seemed to be college students, walked in and took a casual look and asked, "Boss, do you have any preference?"

"What the hell?"

"Preference!!"

One of the female classmates looked at the boss with a strange look, as if looking at an old hater: "You know how to be decent, right? Wei Mu's song."

"Hey. Of course I know Wei Mu, it's decent, the MV is so popular."

Wang Lei patted his head and rummaged through the pile of brand new albums at the door.

Not long after, five brand new albums appeared in his hands.

"Is this it?"

The female classmate took a look and saw a handsome man with outstanding temperament on the album cover.

Her eyes lit up: "That's it, boss, how much does it cost?"

"50 yuan."

"So expensive?"

"There is a photo album inside."

"Okay, I bought it!!"

Not long after, several more young people came, all asking about the "Decent" album.

Wang Lei fawned over him and accepted all the orders.
